text:
Predicates:
Located(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
Named(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Premises:
Cove(barutinCove) ∧ Named(barutinCove, barutin) ∧ Located(barutinCove, snowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is a cove named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin and is located on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
Island(snowIsland) ∧ Island(greenwichIsland) ∧ Island(deceptionIsland) ∧ Located(snowIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ Located(greenwichIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ Located(deceptionIsland, southShetlandIslands) ::: Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island are located in the South Shetland Islands.
Located(antartica, southShetlandIslands) ::: Antarctica is located on the South Shetland Islands.
∀x ∀y ∀z (Located(x, y) ∧ Located(y, z) → Located(x, z)) ::: If place A is located in place B and place B is located in place C, then place A is located in place C.
Conclusion:
¬Located(barutinCove, antartica) ::: Barutin Cove is not located in Antarctica.
